_comment: Canonical MEMBRA proof receipt. Every field is produced by the live Rust implementation. Run: poi demo --fast

worker._comment: Ed25519 worker identity. trust_multiplier gates all collateral signals.

inference._comment: Proof-of-Inference attestation. model_cid is a content-addressed model handle.

kv_state._comment: 32-layer KV cache collateralised with e^(-3t) freshness decay. 6h TTL.

memory._comment: Memory CID in emergent market. emergent_reuse_score drives market_price_lamports.

score_breakdown._comment: Four market signals, each normalised 0–1, composite gated by worker trust.

memgas._comment: Credit grows as market price rises through burst cycles. Consumed via relay.
